claims.disproof_condition: 條件：聯茂、台光電、台燿或其他銅箔基板廠的重訊／年報寫出取消或延後已下單的設備、或同一批設備改向別家採購。核查頻率：每月（MOPS 重訊）＋每年（年報重要契約）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim，重讀含浸機層讀圖的客戶資本承諾段。
claims.statement: Customer-side capital commitment (ITEQ material announcement, 2026-08-28): its subsidiary Inspire Investments Ltd acquired one batch of operating machinery from Asia Metal Industries for about NT$2,101,075 thousand, board-approved on 2026-08-07, decided by price comparison and negotiation. The equipment type is not disclosed.
